Northwind Appliances
Limited Warranty Certificate
Product: Northwind Quietline Dishwasher
Model number: NW-DW500
Serial number: ending 7731
Date of purchase: November 12, 2025
Warranty period: twelve (12) months from the date of purchase.
Warranty provider: Northwind Appliances, Inc. (the Warrantor)
Thank you for choosing Northwind. This certificate describes what the Warrantor will repair or replace, what is not covered, and how to make a claim. Please keep it with your sales receipt.

Section 1. What is covered
During the warranty period, the Warrantor will repair or replace, at its option, any part that fails because of a defect in materials or workmanship under normal household use. Covered parts include the circulation pump, the drain motor, the main control board, the door latch, and the door seals.
Labor for covered repairs is included when performed by a Northwind authorized technician.
Section 2. Proof of purchase
A dated sales receipt is required for all warranty service. Without proof of the purchase date, the Warrantor may decline the claim.

Section 3. What is not covered
This warranty does not cover damage caused by improper installation, including water damage resulting from improperly connected supply or drain lines.
This warranty also does not cover cosmetic damage, damage from commercial use, or damage from repairs made by anyone other than a Northwind authorized technician.
Section 4. How to make a claim
You must report a defect within thirty (30) days of discovering it.
1. Stop using the dishwasher and shut off the water supply.
2. Find your sales receipt, model number, and serial number.
3. Call Northwind Warranty Service at 1-800-555-0142 or email warranty@northwind-appliances.example.
4. A technician visit is scheduled within five (5) business days.
Online: www.northwind-appliances.example/warranty
